🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals — broad sector strength but large-cap divergence (many mega-caps show 1W up vs 1M down), so wait for confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate lead: CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY. Materials strong: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Technology also positive with INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION, SLB (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, GM (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -2.07% | 1M: -12.28%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY; INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY; BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CSCO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -9.80%) BELOW TREND; GM (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.49%) BELOW TREND; CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION; PSX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.98%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY; INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Major divergence flagged — numerous mega-caps show RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) → MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, while AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) RECOVERY and NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY show short-term bounces against weaker 1M — internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Measured improvement but mixed internals: JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND; Financials overall up 1W (1W: +1.65%) but look stock-specific.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious pick-up: LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -0.92%) RECOVERY — sentiment-driven movers underpin momentum but month trends remain mixed.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to pockets of Financials and Materials where 1W strength is backed by select above-trend names (INTC, AMD, INTC/AMD driving tech strength); reduce exposure to persistent BELOW TREND names in Consumer Discretionary and select lagging Tech (NKE, CSCO, UL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector breadth but mega-cap divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate, Materials, Technology (breadth positive). BEARISH: Energy (1W weakness vs 1M strength indicating CORRECTION) and Consumer Discretionary where several names remain BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY — watch near-term resistance for follow-through. AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY — monitor support for continuation. JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY — breakout above recent highs would signal bank-led lift.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+85): LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY — bullish FDA/obesity headlines confirm the 1W lift (accumulation signal). BA (+60): BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — defense/Missile output news aligns with strong 1W but 1M remains weak (divergence). KHC (+55): KHC (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -3.61%) RECOVERY — turnaround headlines supporting short-term rebound, month trend still negative.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CSCO (-50): CSCO (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming price weakness. AAPL (-45): AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY — negative AI/China headlines but 1W bounce creates a negative-sentiment divergence to monitor. BA (-50): BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — safety/quality concern headlines counterbalanced by recent contract news, mixed signals.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) and AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) are showing strength, while CSCO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -1.76%) and NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) show weakness. Key risk is the MAJOR DIVERGENCE — many mega-caps in RECOVERY despite weak 1M, so monitor sentiment movers like LLY (+85) confirming short-term gains and AAPL (-45) for negative-sentiment divergence.
